turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start there.
You're welcome. Now answer the question: who entered that zero before anyone picked up a phone?
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.

You're trading me a mark to make my complaint disappear, Hale, and I'm writing down every word of that. Seventy, today, if I drop it and we never mention it again. The principal will want to hear that offer exactly as you made it.
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
No. "Nobody has to know" is going on the pad, right under the seventy. Withdraw the zero properly, or I go upstairs when we're done.
